about:
Microweld Co., Inc. has operated in Riverside, Rhode Island since its founding in 1959. The company serves the surrounding region with welding and metal fabrication services, describing itself as a provider for every welding service and metal fabrication need in Rhode Island.

The shop provides TIG welding, custom metal fabrication, and machining. Its listed capabilities include shearing, welding, rolling, bending, punching, and milling, with specific mention of metal fabrication and milling services. Microweld also machines a range of products such as nuts and bolts, drill bits, plaques, and flanges, using what it describes as best-quality metals to ensure a high-quality finish with minimal cleanup.

The company works with customers in Rhode Island and the broader area who require welding, fabrication, or machining beyond their own capacity. It highlights specialized TIG welding services and positions itself as a resource when a project is beyond the customer's scope. No specific industry sectors are named in the available information.

Microweld emphasizes its long-standing experience, stating it has met the needs of Rhode Island for every welding service and metal fabrication need since 1959. The company also notes its focus on material quality to deliver a superior finish.
